Name and picture agree. Settings read from the .abr file: 300 px round computed tip (hardness 0%), spacing 25%; tip dynamics: size pen pressure.
use_for: large soft shading, glows and vignettes
avoid: it paints in the current foreground colour (the black in the thumbnail is the renderer's colour, not the preset's)
the pointed ends in the thumbnail come from size set to pen pressure with the renderer's simulated pressure; with a mouse expect an even-width stroke (inferred)
the render scales its canvas to the brush size from about 72 px up, so this thumbnail looks the same as any other preset of the same shape and cannot show the real size difference

cards.how_to_apply: Not in the default Brushes panel list: Brushes panel > panel menu > Import Brushes... and pick <Photoshop 2026 install folder>/Presets/Brushes/Legacy Brushes.abr, then choose 'Soft Round 300 pixels' in its 'Round Brushes with Size' group.
